description: GPS bounding boxes for validating complaint coordinates. Used by EEP validation layer to reject coordinates outside Lebanon and to assign governorate context.

lebanon.note: Full country bounding box. Reject any complaint GPS outside this box.

beirut_city.note: Beirut municipality proper. Water authority = BMLWE. Municipality = Beirut Municipality.

greater_beirut.note: Greater Beirut including Mount Lebanon suburbs. Water authority = BMLWE for most areas.

BMLWE.en: Beirut and Mount Lebanon Water Establishment

validation_rules.note: Reject complaints with GPS coordinates outside Lebanon bounding box. Issue a warning (not rejection) if GPS is outside greater Beirut but still in Lebanon — these are valid but may need different routing context.
